paper.title: Irreducible Generic Gelfand-Tsetlin Modules of $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules for the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$.
